title: Tool
description: A tool (a CLI, a client, an agent runtime) Forge knows how to install into an Image: a version, a Dockerfile fragment that installs it from a pinned, checksummed source, and the binaries it puts on PATH. Twigs provide them (the Catalog), and an admin adds others. A fragment carries no secret and no Environment-specific configuration: the Job's Secrets configure the tools at run time.

id.description: The Tool's name, as Images list it (kubectl, aws, tailscale).

rev.description: Current revision number, assigned by the Hub.

version.description: The tool's version the fragment installs.

install.description: Dockerfile instructions that install the tool after a FROM: RUN, COPY --from=<image>@sha256:<digest>, ENV, ARG, and WORKDIR only (the renderer owns FROM, USER, and ENTRYPOINT). A fragment downloads from a pinned URL and checks its SHA-256; it runs as root at build time. ARG TARGETARCH names the platform being built.

provides.description: The binaries it puts on PATH, each with the command that prints its version (tool.binary Hops and the Heartbeat's tool_versions look for them).

platforms.description: The platforms the fragment supports (default both).

notes.description: The pinned source and checksum, the license, anything a reviewer needs.

version_command.description: Prints the version; default '<binary> --version'. Split into words, no shell.
